_comment: Kenney Car Kit models (CC0) packed for the game by tools/car-kit/pack-cars.js. file = model name in the kit's 'Models/GLB format'; out = file name in assets/vehicles/ (also the asset id: data/assets.json → model.vehicle.<out without 'kenney-'>). Every palette colour is sorted into a material: Paint, Windows, Headlight, Taillight, Trim, Dark, Light (roles = { 'rrggbb': role } to override one). Use those names in data/vehicles.json → types.<id>.model (paint / second / colors).
